scenes.name: Edit schedule on a project
scenes.desc: Under Orion Release Readiness, hover Julian Andrews' allocation (8h/day, Oct 19 to 23) and open Edit allocation from its card. Select Edit Schedule, pick Thu 22 and Fri 23, set 4h/day and Save changes. Julian's bar splits into 8h/day for 3 days and 4h/day for 2 days, and the project row shows 24h / week and 8h / week.
